messages:
ida: anyone up for a quick fika near the Stockholm office around 12:30? need pastry recommendations :coffee:
linus: yes pls, i'm starving :raised_hands:
amelia: Vete-Katten is a classic, 5 min walk from the office. amazing kanelbullar.
ida: ooh love that place. their cardamom buns are unreal.
alex (visiting): I only have one hour between meetings — is it sit-down or grab-and-go?
kevin: quick grab-and-go works. there's also Fabrique for good sourdough + pastries if you want faster line.
ida: vote: Vete-Katten (sit) vs Fabrique (grab). +1 for Vete, +2 for Fabrique?
linus: +1 Fabrique (less of a queue today I think)
amelia: +1 Vete-Katten if we've got time, but I'm fine with Fabrique.
alex (visiting): Fabrique for me — sightseeing time is short.
kevin: pro tip: if we want to be extra Swedish, get a cinnamon bun + coffee from the bakery across the tram stop (name: Mellqvist). cheap and tasty.
ida: noted. i'm dairy-free today though — any recs for almond milk at these spots?
linus: Fabrique usually has oat/almond milk. Vete-Katten can do oat but ask at the counter.
amelia: Mellqvist sometimes runs out of non-dairy milk, but they usually swap in oat.
kevin: i can swing by and pick up a small batch for the team if people want — what to bring? kanelbullar, semla?
ida: semla maybe later in the week. today kanelbullar + one oat latte please :pray:
calendar-bot: Reminder: Ida has "1:1 with Alex" at 13:00 — please wrap up fika by 12:50.
alex (visiting): thanks for the heads up. i'll join but need to be back at 12:55.
linus: plan: meet at office lobby 12:28, split to Fabrique (if no long line) or Vete-Katten. kevin picking up for team.
ida: perfect. see you all in 10 :coffee: :yum:
kevin: i'll grab extras for anyone who wants to snack during the 13:00 meeting — tell me now if you have allergies.
amelia: allergic to peanuts, otherwise fine.
linus: none here.
ida: none for me. thanks kevin!
kevin: noted. i'll leave a sticky note on the pickup box :memo:
alex (visiting): can't wait to try Swedish pastries. thanks everyone! :sweden:
